extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental), immanen- or going beyond, in file order. The commentary carries § 10 and § 25 twice; units cite the first occurrence.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-874): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: Cognition must be investigated not as a fact within a pregiven world but in pure immanence, as absolute givenness in which every actual world first constitutes itself.
units.quote: not in relation to a pregiven actual world and not as a fact within that world, but in pure immanence, as absolute givenness in which every actual world first “constitutes” itself

units.claim: The categorial form a house is no immanent phanological or psychological form.
units.quote: The categorial form “a house” is no immanent phanological or psychological form.

absences.expected_because: The meant objectuality is distinguished here, and §2 places the constitution of every objectuality in cognition studied in pure immanence.
